run_gpt3_agent: run the Gpt3Agent to generate a conversational response using the OpenAI completion API
create_gpt3_completion: create a GPT-3 completion by calling query_completion_api with a full prompt string
configure_gpt3_args: configure GPT-3 command line arguments like model name, temperature, and max tokens
reset_gpt3_agent: reset the Gpt3Agent to clear its observation and conversation turns history
observe_gpt3_turn: observe a conversation turn by appending the user message to the agent turns
